operations.title: Entry 1398 — CCM Semilocal Scaling Quotient Stops Before the Xi Determinant
operations.summary: CCM realizes an exact Xi-divisible entire-function quotient and finite-place self-adjoint ambient scaling pairs, but not one fixed self-adjoint compact-resolvent quotient with completed-Xi determinant.

operations.title: Connes–Consani–Moscovici, Zeta zeros and prolate wave operators
CCM validates the Weil radical preshape but stops before the Xi determinant
operations.statement: The CCM map E and its semilocal extensions give a source-derived radical quotient, exact finite Euler multipliers, and an ambient self-adjoint scaling generator. Exact zero recovery occurs in a quotient of an entire-function topological ring, while the Hilbert scaling model is finite-place and the prolate comparison is limiting. The cited results therefore do not yield a single cutoff-independent self-adjoint compact-resolvent operator whose determinant is completed Xi.
operations.scope: Audit of the published CCM construction; no claim that such a global operator is impossible by other means.

operations.title: Finite-place omitted-prime determinant falsifier
operations.description: For S={infinity,p}, vary an omitted prime q. The finite-S Hilbert pair is unchanged while completed Xi changes by the nonconstant local factor L_q; hence a finite-S determinant cannot equal completed Xi.
